Fans at the stadium witnessed a contest that ebbed and flowed, culminating in a dramatic finish on September 6, 2026. A tight battle of wills Right from the opening whistle, the intensity was palpable, with both FC Dallas and Sporting Kansas City fighting hard for control. The deadlock was finally broken in the 34th minute when Hirving Lozano delivered a pinpoint assist to Robert Taylor , who found the back of the net to put his team ahead. The remainder of the first half remained a scrappy, tactical affair as the sides went into the break. High drama at the death As the second half progressed, the pressure intensified, reflected in the flurry of cautions handed out to Harbor Miller , Hirving Lozano , and Mamadou Fofana .
